reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown read Colossians 2:18's 'unseen' as false teachers' self-vaunted private visions, not the revealed unseen realities faith elsewhere embraces.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the plain reading: Hebrews and John command faith in the unseen while Colossians condemns fixing on the unseen.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: the things which he has not seen
sides.verseText: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
